summary.en: The person as an object: a vermilion square seal with one glyph (我 / Me) that drops in, is dragged by a rope, presses and leaves a round imprint; hollow when the person is away.
summary.zh: “人”这个角色的道具：一方朱红印章，印一个字（我 / Me），落下、被绳子拽、按下、留下圆形印痕；人不在时变空心。

fits: Marking where a person decides or replies; the person being pulled between tasks.
notFor: Approval seals as decoration; machine actions.

intent.en: Make the person a thing on the page, so every press reads as a moment a human had to act.
intent.zh: 把人变成纸面上的一个东西，每按一下就是人不得不出手的一刻。

content.en: One glyph (1 Chinese character, ≤ 3 Latin letters).
content.zh: 一个字（1 个汉字，或 ≤ 3 个拉丁字母）。

fits.zh: 标出人做决定或回复的地方；人在几件事之间被拽来拽去。

notFor.zh: 当装饰用的批准章；机器的动作。

en: One stamp a film: it is the person, not a badge.
An imprint smaller than r 21 makes its glyph fall under the floor; use a solid lamp instead.
zh: 一部片只一方印：它代表人，不是徽章。
印痕半径小于 21 时字会低于字号下限，改用实心灯。

overlaps.note: a worn rubber stamp on a blueprint (keynote); here the seal that stands for the person and is roped around

waive.all: an own brick split from terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
